newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's September CPI rises 14.8 pct on yr.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's September CPI rises 14.8 pct on yr.

text.p: Sri Lanka's consumer price index, based on a 12-month moving average, rose 14.8 percent in September year-on-year against 5.3 percent a year earlier, the Census and Statistics Department said on Tuesday.
In August, the year-on-year CPI rose 13.9 percent, the department said.
The September increase was mainly because of higher prices for bread and wheat flour after the government reduced subsidies, as well as price rises for coconuts and eggs, it said.
But inflation was moderated by lower vegetable prices because of the field crop season, it said without elaborating.
